title: Zot Registry
description: zot OCI registry: fleet, traffic, latency, pulls/pushes, storage, GC, scheduler, runtime. Works with full zot (/metrics) and zot-minimal + zxp exporter.

list.name: version changes
list.expr: count by (instance, version) (zot_info{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) unless count by (instance, version) (zot_info{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} offset 2m)

list.name: fleet_datasource
list.label: Fleet datasources
list.description: Datasources shown in the Fleet rows (one row each). Set a regex to limit to zot Prometheuses.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: External/target label 'cluster'; leave All if you don't have it

list.name: split
list.label: Split by
list.description: Label used for per-member breakdown panels

list.name: dedup_by
list.label: Storage dedup
list.description: How to sum zot_repo_storage_bytes: in a cluster every member may report the same repo
list.query: shared storage / scale-out (per repo) : cluster\, repo,independent instances : cluster\, job\, instance\, repo

list.name: repo
list.label: Repo regex
list.description: Regex applied to repo-level panels, e.g. team-a/.*

panels.title: Fleet · ${fleet_datasource}
panels.description: One row per selected Prometheus datasource. Not affected by cluster/job/instance filters.

targets.expr: count((up{cluster=~".*"} and on (job, instance) last_over_time(zot_info{cluster=~".*"}[1h])) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Scrape targets exposing zot metrics. For zot-minimal this is the zxp exporter.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: In a hash-proxied scale-out cluster a proxied request is counted on both the entry member and the owning member.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: From zot_http_method_latency_seconds (buckets .05 .5 1 5 30 60 600s) — coarse.

panels.title: Pulls/min
panels.description: Successful manifest GETs (image pulls), blobs not counted

panels.title: Pushes/min
panels.description: Successful manifest PUTs (image pushes)

panels.title: Storage
panels.description: Sum of zot_repo_storage_bytes, deduplicated by $dedup_by. Empty for S3/remote storage.

panels.title: Repositories
panels.description: Repos with a storage size metric (local storage only)

panels.title: Storage growth/day
panels.description: Linear trend over last 6h

panels.title: Versions
panels.description: Number of instances per zot version

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Scrape status and build info per target

targets.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, version, commit, binaryType, goVersion) (last_over_time(zot_info{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[1h]) * 0 + 1) * on (job, instance) group_left() max by (job, instance) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Requests by $split
panels.description: Load distribution across members. Proxied requests are counted on both hops.

panels.title: Errors by code
panels.description: 404 on HEAD is normal during push (blob existence checks)

targets.expr: (sum by ($split) (rate(zot_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by ($split) (rate(zot_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by ($split) (rate(zot_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

(sum by ($split) (rate(zot_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by ($split) (rate(zot_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by ($split) (rate(zot_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency quantiles (all methods)
panels.description: Quantiles are interpolated between coarse buckets (.05 .5 1 5 30 60 600s)

panels.title: Request latency distribution
panels.description: Filtered by $method

panels.title: Slowest repos (avg latency in range)
panels.description: Repos with >20 requests in range; includes blob transfers, so big images look slow

targets.expr: topk(15, (sum by (repo) (increase(zot_http_repo_latency_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo",repo!="N/A"}[$__range])) / sum by (repo) (increase(zot_http_repo_latency_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo",repo!="N/A"}[$__range]))) and on (repo) (sum by (repo) (increase(zot_http_repo_latency_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo"}[$__range])) > 20))

panels.title: Pulls & pushes /min
panels.description: Pushes drawn below the axis

panels.title: Pulls /min by repo prefix
panels.description: Prefix = first path component of the repo name; top 10

panels.title: Pulls /min by $split
panels.description: In a hash-proxied cluster this shows which member owns the hot repos

panels.title: Storage
panels.description: zot_repo_storage_bytes is only computed for local filesystem storage

panels.title: Storage change /h by repo prefix
panels.description: Top 10 prefixes by absolute change; negative = freed (GC/delete)

targets.expr: (sum by (prefix) (label_replace(max by ($dedup_by) (deriv(zot_repo_storage_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo"}[30m])), "prefix", "$1", "repo", "([^/]+).*")) * 3600) and on (prefix) topk(10, abs(sum by (prefix) (label_replace(max by ($dedup_by) (deriv(zot_repo_storage_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",repo=~"$repo"}[30m])), "prefix", "$1", "repo", "([^/]+).*")) * 3600))

panels.title: Storage by $split
panels.description: Raw per-member values (not deduplicated): shows how repos are spread over members

panels.title: Avg GC duration by $split
panels.description: 30m window: GC runs are rare

targets.expr: sum by ($split, lockType) (rate(zot_storage_lock_latency_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by ($split, lockType) (rate(zot_storage_lock_latency_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Go runtime & process
CPU by $split
panels.description: 1.0 = one core
Full zot build only; with zot-minimal these are the zxp exporter's own metrics
